evidence_items.explanation: The revised analysis estimates substantial inference expenses and approximately break-even operation before research costs for the GPT-5 product bundle. It supports the proposed mechanism, but covers part of 2025 and uses estimated margins with exclusions rather than a matching company-wide profit measure.
